verdict.rationale: Superset gives agents access to a repository once you add it from a local folder or clone it from GitHub. Each agent then works in its own worktree. Cloning depends on the host's existing GitHub CLI login rather than a dedicated one-click install, and per-project setup/teardown scripts may also be needed. missing for 10: a documented one-click repo-access install or app-based authorization flow, independent hands-on corroboration that onboarding is effortless.
